_comment: Copy this file to your SFDX project root as swarm.config.json and fill in your values.

project.name: My Salesforce Project
project.description: Short description of what this org is for

org.comment: Leave blank to use sf CLI default org (.sf/config.json target-org)

jira.comment: Your Jira project key — used by Jira Analyst to search tickets

promotion.comment: Where your promotion repo lives (for sfdc-promotion-workflow)

agents.comment: Which model to use for agents. 'auto' lets Cursor pick.

cursor.comment: Get your API key at cursor.com/dashboard/integrations

slack.comment: Optional — Slack workspace for sending messages
